_comment: Reviewed-and-accepted dead-code findings. Each entry has a verified rationale in _orphaned_rationale. ghost_calls: 'METHOD /api/path' the matcher mis-flags. orphaned_endpoints: 'METHOD /api/path' where the function is fulfilled by another consumer (scanner blind spot, peer-protocol, external consumer, in-container script, etc.) or genuinely admin-only with no end-user-facing intent.

_orphaned_rationale.GET /: FastAPI root health-check endpoint — external monitoring only.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/health: Service-level health endpoint scraped by external monitoring (Prometheus, k8s, etc.). Not UI-callable.
_orphaned_rationale.POST /api/knowledge/search: Fabric peer-protocol surface — used by other Augmentum instances over P2P, not the UI. GET variant IS UI-wired (browse.js).
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/version: Ollama-compat probe — called by external clients (Open WebUI, SillyTavern) advertising compatibility. Not UI-facing.
_orphaned_rationale.POST /api/audio/speech: OpenAI-compat TTS surface — called by external SDK clients. UI uses /api/tts/* internally.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/avatar/{avatar_id}/portrait: Image bytes — consumed via , not fetch. Scanner can't see src attribute assignments.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/browse/image: SSRF-safe image proxy — consumed via inside rendered article HTML. Scanner can't see src attribute assignments.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/cast/blob/{token}: Public token-blob URL — consumed by external DLNA/Cast receiver devices (TVs, phones), not this UI.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/cast/pair/android-tv/version: Called from the Android TV receiver APK (UpdateChecker.kt) via HttpsURLConnection, not the JS frontend. Self-upgrade poll.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/cast/pair/android-tv/download: Called from the Android TV receiver APK (UpdateChecker.kt) to download the new APK. Public so pre-pair kiosks can self-update; integrity is Android's package-signature check.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/surface-public/{token}/media/st: Public surface media stream — consumed by external devices following a shared link, not this UI.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/media/comic/page/{file_id}: Comic page image bytes — consumed via in comic-reader/index.js. Scanner can't see src attribute assignments.
_orphaned_rationale.POST /api/companion/narrative/frame_brea: Backend self-call — the same `detect_frame_break()` function is invoked in-process from companion_runtime/voice.py:195,226. HTTP surface kept as parallel API for external clients.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/animations/{animation_id}/file: Animation bytes — URL is constructed server-side as the row's `source` field and passed to playVrma(entry.source), not fetched via a literal JS path. Scanner can't trace the indirection. List/upload/update/delete ARE UI-wired (becca-presence.js).
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/coder/git-credential: Called from INSIDE the coder workspace container by the git-credential helper script (containers.py:149) — not a browser call.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/coder/checkpoints/{workspace_id: Coder admin endpoint — feature exists but the diff viewer UI lives in coder-review.js for accept/reject flow, not arbitrary checkpoint diff. Could be wired in a future deep-history surface.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/coder/files/{workspace_id}/down: Single-file download — superseded by /api/coder/workspaces/{ws}/export (workspace tar.gz) for the existing UI flow. Kept as a more-granular API.
_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/coder/search/{workspace_id}: Semantic code search — the agent calls search_index() directly via CodeSearchTool (tools.py:2182), not the HTTP endpoint. HTTP kept for cross-process or external IDE plugins.
_orphaned_rationale.POST /api/coder/workspaces/{workspace_id: Container lifecycle — managed via the WebSocket terminal handshake (coder_routes.py:1602) so the HTTP start endpoint is a fallback for non-terminal use cases.
Container lifecycle — see /start. Stop is implicit on workspace switch via WS teardown.
Manual git commit — coder mode commits via the agent's GitTool.execute() → container exec (tools.py:2453), not the HTTP endpoint. HTTP kept for non-coder-mode use.

_orphaned_rationale.GET /api/coder/workspaces/{workspace_id}: Workspace services managed by the coder agent via WorkspaceServiceManager.list() (runtime_tools.py:114). HTTP kept for future operator UI.
_orphaned_rationale.POST /api/coder/workspaces/{workspace_id: Coder agent starts services via WorkspaceServiceManager.start() (runtime_tools.py:79). HTTP kept for future operator UI.
Coder agent probes via WorkspaceServiceManager.probe(). HTTP kept for future operator UI.
